name: Seared Scallop Salad with Balsamic Roasted Grapes, Avocado & Feta
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Transfer grapes to a large baking dish; drizzle with oil and vinegar, then season with salt. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until grapes begin to swell, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot. Place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add scallops in a single layer and cook until they develop a nice sear and are opaque throughout, 1½-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
When the grapes are done, remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly, 5 minutes.

While the grapes are cooling, halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl with the dressing along with the mixed greens and feta; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with grapes and scallops. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
